title: Balanced Cutoff Learner Work Bound
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers and let $\delta$ be rational with $0<\delta\le 1/2$. Put $r=\lceil 3k/4\rceil$, $\ell=k-r$, and $m=2^\ell\bigl(M_{n,\ell}+b_\delta\bigr)$, where $M_{n,\ell}$ is the number of subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ of size at most $\ell$, and $b_\delta$ is the ceiling of the base-$2$ logarithm of $\lceil 2/\delta\rceil$. For any $m$ labeled samples from the sign cube of dimension $n$, the work of the degree-$\ell$ polynomial learner is at most $C_{\ell,\delta}(n+1)^r$, where $C_{\ell,\delta}$ is the coefficient specified by the cubic solver exponent certificate.
hypotheses_covered: The sample family has the prescribed size $m$
Each sample is a sign-cube input of dimension $n$ paired with a sign label
